name: Combinational Logic (Tutorial 1)
description: 2 buttons (PB10/PB11) drive 4 LEDs (PB12-PB15) by a truth table: neither pressed is all OFF, either pressed lights its own pair, both pressed is all ON. No debounce on purpose -- this tutorial is about reading a level and applying combinational logic.

name: Blink Simple
description: Standard LED heartbeat on PB2. Uses SysTick for deterministic millisecond delays.

name: USB UART Echo
description: Interactive serial communication. Echoes back received characters and reports system uptime every 2 seconds.

name: UART Multi-FSM Dispatcher
description: Three independent table-driven FSMs (LED/MOTOR/UART) sharing the same 2-state transition table, dispatched by whichever key ('l'/'m'/'u') arrives over serial -- plus the same non-blocking echo and 2s heartbeat as USB UART Echo.

name: LED Progress Sequence
description: Progressive sequence using pins PB12-PB15. Demonstrates sequential I/O control and multi-pin configuration.

name: Relay Module (Tutorial 3)
description: Drives a 2-channel opto-isolated relay module on PB10/PB11. Demonstrates active-low trigger logic: a LOW signal energizes the coil, a HIGH releases it.

name: Non-Blocking Blink (millis style)
description: Blinks PB2 every 500ms WITHOUT delay_ms() -- checks msTicks each loop pass instead of blocking, so the rest of while(1) is always free to run.

name: Binary Manipulator (Taller 2)
description: Integrates all 20 pins from Taller 2: 6 LEDs show a binary number, 2 multiplexed 7-segment displays show its decimal value, and 4 debounced buttons move a cursor, toggle a bit, and clear -- all non-blocking.

name: External Interrupt (EINT) Button
description: Reacts to a button press via a real hardware interrupt on EINT line 10 (PA10) instead of polling IDATA -- PB2 toggles instantly inside the ISR, while the main loop keeps blinking its own heartbeat on PA8, completely untouched.

name: Independent Watchdog (IWDT)
description: Feeds the IWDT every loop pass (~2s timeout) while blinking PB2. Hold the button on PA10 to simulate a firmware hang: the watchdog resets the board on its own, and PA8 blinks 3 times on the next boot to prove RCM->CSTS caught the IWDT reset.

name: Table-Driven FSM (Toggle)
description: Hardware port of the class example (11_mquinas/fsm_table.c): the same State/Event/Cell table and fsm_dispatch() pattern, but EV_BTN now comes from a debounced PA10 and the actions drive PB2 instead of printf.

name: Potentiometer / ADC Reading (Tutorial 4)
description: Reads a potentiometer's wiper voltage on PA2 (ADC1 Channel 2) as a 12-bit value and turns it into a 6-LED bar graph on the same PB12-PB15/PA8/PA9 LEDs used in Taller 2.

name: Real-Time Clock (Tutorial 5)
description: Unlocks the backup domain, starts the Blue Pill's onboard 32.768kHz crystal, and ticks RTC->CNTL once per second -- no extra hardware. Displays the last two digits of the seconds counter on the same multiplexed 7-segment setup from Tutorial 2.
